scope: Read-only review of actual R06 GPU frames and reversible R07 diagnostic evidence; no product or original evidence changes.

conclusion.target: The narrow hard lower inner-lip boundary beside the lower teeth in jaw and speaking poses.
conclusion.finding: The target remains narrow and sharply bounded in both no-bump and albedo frames. Removing procedural normal relief barely changes its pixels. The material-only evidence favors investigating the actual return geometry, envelope, interpolated mesh normals and occlusion; it does not by itself identify a particular geometric stage as causal.
conclusion.scopeLimit: This conclusion concerns the photographed localized inner edge on one frozen person, not all lip material quality or all expressions.
conclusion.nextAdjustment: Do not increase whole-lip volume or tune wetness on this evidence. Use the indexed native/draw sections and reversible stage evidence to locate the actual lower-lip return before choosing a constrained structural change.

visualObservations.observation: No-bump mainly removes fine skin shading; the narrow lower lip boundary beside teeth remains.

Albedo removes illumination and the R04 post-light depth-visibility multiplier, while retaining geometry, occlusion and authored color. A broader rounded lower return does not emerge merely from this change.

Orange/brown oral color is visible toward the mouth corner, distinct from the pink exterior. A palette/domain transition exists, but its presence alone does not establish wrong ownership or explain the central lower hard edge.
The exterior lower lip body already reads as rounded in the original beauty frames; these frames do not support uniformly inflating the whole lip.

noBumpTargetROI.definition: Maximum absolute RGB channel difference per pixel, original versus no-bump; integer display DN. Coordinates are half-open [x0,y0,x1,y1] in 640 x 512 images. Descriptive evidence, not an aesthetic acceptance score.

isolationEvidence.surfaceReports: All six diagnostic surface reports have pendingHashes=0, hashEvidenceComplete=true and errors=[].
isolationEvidence.preserved: Native and draw geometry, canonical and before-local bytes, semantics, original material owners, parameters, native uniform objects/values, camera, lighting and native function/solver hook identities were exact in the diagnostic reports.
isolationEvidence.restoration: All three pose/view windows restore native state, actual pixels, actual shader and R05/R06 solver call counts exactly.
isolationEvidence.noBumpMeaning: Restores fbGeomN after the normal psH block and before the clearcoat normal block. It preserves geometry and geometric/interpolated mesh normals; it is not a zero-normal or zero-geometry experiment.
isolationEvidence.albedoMeaning: Sets outgoingLight=psBase before the opaque fragment chunk. It retains authored optical partition colors, alpha/occlusion and silhouette while bypassing accumulated lighting and R04 outgoingLight depth visibility.

opticalPartitionAssessment.source: ../lip-inner-r04/MucosaSurface.js and the actual original-r06 final fragment template in this evidence.
opticalPartitionAssessment.oralWeight: liOral = clamp(vL19State.x,0,1) * clamp(vCSRegion.x,0,1) * (1-step(.5,vCSType)); liWeight also requires liEnabled and uLEnabled.
opticalPartitionAssessment.upperLower: liUpper is a hard rest-space split at the midpoint of lrInnerTop/lrInnerBottom. It is independent from the R05 motion-carrier repair. Whether that classification is wrong on the visible target remains unproven.
opticalPartitionAssessment.effects: The R04 block blends base color, roughness and clearcoat, attenuates psH, and multiplies outgoingLight by mix(1,.12+.88*exp(-max(0,vL19Detail.w)*120),liWeight). The added block does not create a new alpha cut or geometric silhouette.
opticalPartitionAssessment.caveat: Albedo is not an independent ablation of oral weight, upper/lower palette or the visibility term. Current frames cannot apportion these terms individually.

semanticCounterexample.meaning: detailW=1 must not be read as strong mucosal darkening at this point: the oral weight is zero.

oralExample.meaning: This distinct native point has an active oral optical response. It is not assumed to be connected to the other point, a visible fragment, or a tissue-thickness measurement.

remainingUncertainty: A shared hard edge under beauty/no-bump/albedo does not alone separate native envelope shape, evaluated mesh normals, contact/closure and occlusion.
Raw semantic v, detail.w and gaps between arbitrary points are not physical lip-edge thickness.
No current evidence demonstrates that increasing wetness or changing global material parameters would repair the localized return.
